remarks: Welcome to 13 Burchard Lane, a charming Cape-style home nestled in Rowayton. This delightful home offers a cozy and welcoming atmosphere with its classic design and modern updates. Step inside to discover a clean white kitchen, perfectly equipped with stainless steel appliances that will inspire your culinary adventures.   The home boasts four comfortable bedrooms and two brand new full bathrooms, providing ample space for relaxation and privacy. The living area features a warm and inviting wood-burning fireplace, perfect for cozying up on cooler evenings.   Head outside to enjoy the deck, ideal for entertaining or simply unwinding while overlooking the large yard. The property also includes a garage, offering convenience and additional storage options. Located on a serene street, this home provides a peaceful setting while still being conveniently close to all that the vibrant community has to offer.   With its blend of charm and contemporary amenities, don't miss this opportunity to make this captivating Cape your own personal haven for the next year. Schedule your showing today and experience the warmth and character of this beautiful property for yourself.
